faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Senior Research Fellow position at Punjab Agricultural University is 16 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Sc. degree in Agriculture or related fields with a minimum OCPA of 6.00/10.00 or 60% marks, and a Master's Degree in Agronomy or equivalent with a minimum OCPA of 6.50/10.00 or 65% marks, along with NET qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37000/- plus 16% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow position at Punjab Agricultural University through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the PAU Senior Research Fellow recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 200/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Fellow position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, which is https://www.pau.edu.

faq.question: Q9. What is the interview date for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Senior Research Fellow position is scheduled to be held on 22 September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Senior Research Fellow position at Punjab Agricultural University is a contractual job.
